title_en: Luxurious Penthouse for sale inside the "Colombo 2" residence, in front of the artificial lake of Tirana,
description_en: Luxurious Penthouse for sale inside the "Colombo 2" residence, in front of the artificial Lake of Tirana, and with an open view of the Lake, as well as the entire view of the Dajti mountain. The Penthouse has a south-east orientation. The Total Area is 231.7 m 2 of which the Net Area of the Apartment is 155 m2, the Area of the Veranda is 61.7 m2, the Area of Common 15.5 Its organization: Distribution Corridor Living Room with Kitchen Area 3 Bedrooms with considerable surface area 2 Toilets 1 Veranda with exit from the Living Room 3 Balconies with exit from the Bedrooms Other information on the property: * Investment made in 2023 in the amount of 100,000 Euro, which includes the Electrical System, the Hydraulic System, the Polysterene Cover System (Thermal Insulation Material) of high quality Chiller System 3 Phase Heating-Cooling in every environment Solar panels for sanitary water and showers. Alarm system and 24-hour water camera system inside the Penthouse with individual deposits * All rooms are equipped with oak parquet, * The furniture is mainly antique * Equipped with a functional fireplace with natural wood * Storage for storing wood The residence is managed by a staff qualified which offers all maintenance services and is monitored 24/24. The price is 500,000 euros
